how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for Raipur District Support Person Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Download the application form from the official website: https://raipur.gov.in.
Fill the application form carefully with correct information.
Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates.
Check all details carefully before submission.
Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed.
Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 15-10-2026.
Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for Raipur District Support Person Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: https://raipur.gov.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 15-10-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by Raipur District in the state of Chhattisgarh for filling up various contractual positions as per the latest employment notification.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised by Raipur District?
faq.answer: The advertised post name is Support Person, which requires specific educational qualifications and experience in child development and protection fields.

faq.question: Q3. What is the mode of application for Raipur District Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is completely offline. Candidates must download the form, fill it, and send it to the designated official address.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date for the submission of the application form or expression of interest (EOI) is 15-10-2026. Make sure your application reaches on time.

faq.question: Q5. What is the required educational qualification for Support Person?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Post Graduate degree in Social Work, Sociology, Psychology, or Child Development, or a Graduate degree with 3 years of relevant experience.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for General and OBC candidates?
faq.answer: No, the application fee for General and OBC candidates is Nil. All categories can apply without paying any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process includes document verification, presentation for NGOs, personal interview, police verification, and final empanelment approved by the District Collector.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary or honorarium provided for this role?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive an honorarium as per the Minimum Wages Act 1948 for skilled workers on a proportional basis plus actual travel expenses.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I download the official notification PDF and application form?
faq.answer: You can download the official notification and application form from the official website of Raipur District at https://raipur.gov.in.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for the Support Person vacancy?
faq.answer: The job type for the Support Person position is purely contractual under the government sector in Raipur District, Chhattisgarh.
